title: Auditory and Visual Rhythm Omission EEG
description: This EEG dataset comprises recordings from 18 participants engaged in auditory and visual rhythm perception tasks using an omission paradigm. The study dissociates predictive neural mechanisms from sensory-evoked activity by presenting rhythmic stimuli with occasional omissions in both auditory and visual modalities. Comprehensive preprocessing code, time-frequency analysis, frequency band extraction, and statistical procedures are provided, with cluster analysis performed using EEGLAB.
methods_description: EEG recordings were obtained from 18 participants during separate auditory and visual rhythm perception tasks. Stimulus trains in both modalities contained occasional omissions to enable separation of predictive neural activity from sensory-evoked responses. Preprocessing, time-frequency computation, frequency band extraction, and statistical analysis were performed using provided code, with cluster formation conducted via EEGLAB Study function.
